payload.content: This database uses SQLite. Use SQLite-only date/time syntax: STRFTIME('%Y', date_column) for year extraction; STRFTIME('%Y', date('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', birth_date) for age in years; date('now') for the current date. NEVER use PostgreSQL idioms (DATE_PART, AGE(), EXTRACT, NOW(), CURDATE(), TIMESTAMPDIFF) — they will fail.
